test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ancient Greeks and Romans used to worship natural _______ as Gods and Goddesses.
solution:
The correct answer is '**elements**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**elements**" in this context refers to the fundamental constituents of the natural world. (प्राकृतिक दुनिया के मूलभूत घटक)
 
• Ancient civilizations often personified natural forces like the sun, moon, water, fire, and earth as deities.
 
• The other options: "**impulses**," "**mixtures**," and "**instincts**" do not fit the historical and religious context of ancient Greek and Roman worship.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The ancient Greeks and Romans used to worship natural elements__ as Gods and Goddesses.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Impulses (आवेग)**: sudden strong urges or desires to act.
 
• **Mixtures (मिश्रण)**: substances consisting of two or more components mixed together without chemical bonding.
 
• **Instincts (सहज वृत्ति)**: innate, typically fixed patterns of behavior in animals in response to certain stimuli.

41:Td4e,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
